description: v0-repo-full with offline release-note + PR/Issue body context (SWE-EVO paper Appendix N.1 style).
selection_rule: Same 14 instance ids as v0-repo-full; problem_statement augmented from eval/data/pr-issue-cache (GitHub bodies only; never patch_without_test).
